items.title_zh: 女性对 19 世纪 Qawwali 的看法，称赞 Kanhaiya 是“Bahut Khoob”
items.title_en: Woman's Take On 19th Century Qawwali Praising Kanhaiya Is 'Bahut Khoob'
items.summary_zh: 这首特定的 thumri，Kanhayya Yaad Hai，是由 Nawab Sadiq Jung Bahadur Hilm 在 19 世纪按照奉爱传统创作的。
items.summary_en: This specific thumri, Kanhayya Yaad Hai, was composed in the bhakti tradition by Nawab Sadiq Jung Bahadur Hilm in the 19th century.
